cn_title: 帕特里克·斯图尔特逝世，享年86岁
subtitle: 告别皮卡德舰长
opus_summary: 帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士于10月28日逝世，享年86岁，家人次日发布声明。他以皮卡德舰长和X教授闻名，《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》将成为他的银幕绝唱。

paragraphs.en: Acclaimed actor Sir Patrick Stewart (Star Trek: The Next Generation, the X-Men franchise) died today at the age of 86 following a brief battle with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.
paragraphs.cn: 曾出演《星际迷航：下一代》和《X战警》系列的知名演员帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士，在与阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆短暂抗争后，于今日去世，享年86岁。

paragraphs.en: His family posted a statement about his death to social media on October 29, a day after his death on the 28.
paragraphs.cn: 斯图尔特于10月28日去世，家人于次日，也就是10月29日，在社交媒体上发布了他的逝世声明。

paragraphs.en: “He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” wrote family spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak. “We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace.”
paragraphs.cn: 家属发言人Kelly Bush Novak写道：「他始终被家人和朋友温暖地拥在怀中，身边有现场演奏的音乐、祈祷、泪水、欢笑，还有那份深沉的情感——他一生为我们所有人倾尽心力，唯有他能唤起这样的情感。我们会永远珍视他脸上的安详与沉思，那将永远提醒我们，他的优雅从未被击倒。」

paragraphs.en: A veteran of the British stage blessed with a rich, commanding voice, Stewart was 47 when he was cast as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation. The role vaulted the Shakespearean actor to international fame. Stewart would reprise the role for the TNG films as well as his own spin-off streaming series Picard.
paragraphs.cn: 斯图尔特是英国舞台剧界的资深演员，嗓音浑厚而威严。他在47岁时获选，在《星际迷航：下一代》中饰演让-吕克·皮卡德舰长。这个角色让这位莎士比亚戏剧演员蜚声国际。此后，斯图尔特又在《星际迷航：下一代》的系列电影，以及以他的角色为主角的流媒体衍生剧《星际迷航：皮卡德》中，再度出演皮卡德。

paragraphs.en: Stewart was cast as Professor Charles Xavier in 2000's X-Men in part because, as director Bryan Singer once jokingly said, Stewart was perfect as a bald man sitting in a chair giving orders. He played the character in the X-Men films and later in the MCU in both Doctor Strange and the Multiverse of Madness and in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday, which will mark Stewart's final screen appearance.
paragraphs.cn: 斯图尔特在2000年的《X战警》中获选饰演查尔斯·泽维尔教授，部分原因正如导演布莱恩·辛格曾开玩笑所说：让斯图尔特扮演一个坐在椅子上发号施令的光头，再合适不过了。他在《X战警》系列电影中饰演这个角色，后来又在漫威电影宇宙的《奇异博士2：疯狂多元宇宙》和即将上映的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中出演该角色。后者将成为斯图尔特最后一部银幕作品。

paragraphs.en: Born on July 13, 1940, in Mirfield, Yorkshire, England, Stewart's other film and TV credits include Excalibur, David Lynch's Dune, Robin Hood: Men in Tights, Green Room, Moby Dick, The Prince of Egypt, TMNT, The Sheep Detectives, American Dad, Ted, and I, Claudius.
paragraphs.cn: 斯图尔特于1940年7月13日出生在英国英格兰约克郡的米尔菲尔德。他参演的其他影视作品包括《黑暗时代》、大卫·林奇执导的《沙丘》，以及《罗宾汉也疯狂》《绿色房间》《白鲸》《埃及王子》《忍者神龟》《绵羊侦探团》《美国老爸》《泰迪熊》和《我，克劳狄乌斯》。

paragraphs.en: For many years, Stewart played Ebenezer Scrooge in a one-man stage production of A Christmas Carol, reprising the role in a made-for-TV movie adaptation.
paragraphs.cn: 多年来，斯图尔特一直在独角舞台剧《圣诞颂歌》中饰演埃比尼泽·斯克鲁奇，并在一部电视电影改编版中再次出演这一角色。

paragraphs.en: Stewart also voiced characters in video games such as Castlevania: Lords of Shadow, Forgotten Realms: Demon Stone, Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos and The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion.
paragraphs.cn: 斯图尔特还曾为《恶魔城：暗影之王》《被遗忘的国度：恶魔之石》《大地传说：混沌王座》和《上古卷轴4：湮灭》等游戏中的角色配音。

paragraphs.en: In lieu of flowers, his family asks fans to send memorial contributions to the J ohns Hopkins Alzheimer’s Disease Research Center Fund and the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America Caregiver Resources.
paragraphs.cn: 他的家人希望粉丝不要送花，而是向约翰斯·霍普金斯大学阿尔茨海默病研究中心基金和美国阿尔茨海默病基金会的照护者资源项目捐款，以寄托哀思。
